item.title: Rallying Cry – October 27, 2026
item.description: From groundbreaking medical breakthroughs like an experimental antibody keeping an HIV-like virus in remission for four years in monkeys to inspiring community efforts like a Winnipegger raising funds for CancerCare with giant jack-o’-lanterns, today’s news is full of hope and progress!
